newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Sateras buys land, cement plant.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Sateras buys land, cement plant.

text.p: Sateras Resources (Malaysia) Bhd said on Thursday it was buying two pieces of land and an integrated cement plant from United Chemical Industries Bhd (UCI) for 800 million ringgit.
At an agreement signing ceremony, Sateras officials said one of the pieces of land measured 404,690 square metres, which holds the cement plant, while the other is 257.37 hectares in size.
Both pieces of land are located in the north eastern state of Kelantan.
Property developer Sateras said the acquisitions will be paid by the issue of 320 million new shares at 2.50 ringgit each.
At the end of the exercise, UCI, previously a maker of plastic products, would own 41.3 percent of the enlarged paid up capital of Sateras.
UCI received the land and cement assets from just-acquired Hongkew Holdings (M) Sdn Bhd, the agreement of which was also signed on Thursday.

Sateras managing director Mohamed Kamal Hussain said at the signing ceremony that the acquisitions positioned the company as a major cement producer. Sateras recently acquired a company with interest in two cement plants in Dalian, China.
Mohamed Kamal said the company's entry into the cement industry would also complement its property development division.
Shares of Sateras and UCI were suspended on Wednesday pending announcement. Sateras was last traded at 2.10 ringgit and UCI at 18.20 ringgit.
